definitions.biomass_non_decreasing: total biomass never decreases (the model has no explicit biomass loss term; senescence moves leaf to stem)
definitions.dormancy_gates_thermal_time: perennials accumulate no GDD before dormancy release
definitions.finite_state: every numeric crop, soil, weather, microclimate and environment value is finite
definitions.harvest_ready_persistent: harvest_ready never returns to False once True
definitions.maturity_bounds_monotonic: maturity_index stays in [0, 1] and never decreases
definitions.microclimate_contract: 0 <= RH <= 100, CO2 >= 0, radiation >= 0 in the microclimate state
definitions.normalized_factors: growth factor in [0, 1] and actual growth <= potential growth
definitions.post_harvest_no_growth: no biomass gain and no LAI gain during post_harvest_dormancy
definitions.soil_water_contract: wilting_point <= VWC <= field_capacity and root-zone water >= 0
definitions.stage_monotonic: phenological stage index never decreases and a finished cycle is never reactivated
definitions.thermal_time_monotonic: GDD and chilling hours never decrease
definitions.time_continuity: snapshot i is at start + (i + 1) * dt: no reset, gap or double advance
